problem_keywords: distinguishing broken stores from empty stores
propositions: _tracker() uses bare os.path.isdir(tracker) as its sole initialization predicate, so a directory that exists but lacks .git or has an unresolvable HEAD satisfies the guard and incorrectly returns [] instead of raising store_uninitialized

A broken store (directory present, no .git, no ticket data) is indistinguishable from an empty initialized store under the current check, violating the guard's intent to prevent silent fallback-masking
A mid-clone store (directory present, .git present but HEAD unresolvable) similarly reads [] instead of raising, even though it is not usable
The read-side and write-side initialization checks disagree: writes reject .git-less stores but reads only check directory presence, creating a read/write asymmetry on the same store shapes
